about: OFFICIAL PINS from the Nov 11 outside search (Brandon, Nov 12 2026), staged here because no bot reads pin fills yet and data/point-circles.json feeds the running 2-fer rules. action: pin-fill = POTA has no usable pin (0,0 or absent), this fills it and moves nothing; point-circle-candidate = official point within 0.5 km of the POTA pin and the park has no outline (100 ft circle; card notes there is no boundary); held = the official point is more than 0.5 km away (never moves a pin, a person checks). Never a boundary, never a key outline. OWNER CALL: when shares_pota_pin_with is not empty, two parks would get the same circle and the 2-fer finder would pair them, so a person decides before any of these go into data/point-circles.json.
